### Planning Intelligence Log

**Session date**: 2026-05-25
**Origin**: Placeholder epic 8e5a-c720-2941-4bd0 from the UI/UX quality proposal report (labeled "Plan B — highest-leverage single addition" of five plans A-E). User invoked /dso:brainstorm to expand from placeholder to full spec.

**Probe A empirical observation (bug 95f1-99b8-37b4-472d)**: During Step 2.25 cross-epic scan, the orchestrator dispatched all 31 haiku classifier batches in a single message without surfacing cost framing, without offering "halt all" or partial coverage, and without debating dispatch volume. This contrasts with the prior brainstorm session in this conversation (epic 7315), where the orchestrator dispatched only 6 of 30 batches under cost-anxiety. The step-local positive directive injected at the head of the Step 2.25 HARD-GATE — "Dispatch every batch in this step. User authorization at skill entry covers all dispatches required by Step 2.25." — measurably shifted the dispatch decision. Single observation; needs replication to draw a calibration conclusion, but the directional signal is consistent with the Instruction Locality (#16) hypothesis from the bot-psychologist's analysis.

**Design decisions (user-guided through Phase 1 dialogue)**:

- **Scope**: All four integration surfaces (agent + skill + Integration A + Integration B + 5th committee reviewer + calibration corpus) in scope for one epic. Split decisions deferred to preplanning.
- **Iteration model (Integration A)**: Attribution-based routing — implementation_drift → re-prompt implementer; design_flaw → re-dispatch /dso:ui-designer; mixed/uncertain/low-confidence → user dialog. Discriminator is `intent_match` (rendered-vs-spec).
- **Auto-routing gate**: Only high-confidence attributions auto-route; medium/low go to user dialog. Threshold set by agent's own confidence, not hardcoded.
- **Reviewer-committee semantics**: Split visual_hierarchy into two structurally distinct dimensions — design-systems-lead keeps `visual_hierarchy_intent` (text intent reasoning); new 5th reviewer owns `visual_hierarchy_legibility` (pixel-observable).
- **Scoring dimensions**: 5 — `whitespace_balance`, `element_density`, `visual_hierarchy_legibility`, `alignment_grid_adherence`, `intent_match`. `intent_match` is structurally the attribution discriminator.
- **Iteration-exhaustion failure mode**: Conditional — `intent_match` below threshold blocks task; quality-dim-only shortfalls annotate `visual_debt:<dimension>` and proceed.
- **Design manifest contents**: Synthesized at runtime from `.claude/design-notes.md` + route metadata + task ticket body + Figma frame (when `design.figma_collaboration` enabled, graceful-degrade otherwise).
- **VLM model assignment**: Sonnet 4.6 inline (extended thinking) / Opus 4.7 post-batch. Verified all three current Claude 4.x models support vision per Anthropic docs (Jan 2026 knowledge cutoff).
- **Score thresholds**: Tunable via dso-config.conf (`visual_evaluator.iteration_threshold`, `visual_evaluator.success_median`, `visual_evaluator.cache_max_entries`, `visual_evaluator.iteration_cap`). Iteration threshold default 3 of 5 (was placeholder's 4; lowered to absorb red-team's non-determinism finding).
- **Integration B JSON shape**: 5th committee reviewer at `plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/visual-spatial-evaluator.md` emits own JSON at the same path/key shape as the existing 4 reviewers; arbitration combines all 5.
- **Calibration corpus methodology**: Hybrid — initial heuristic from last 10 merged UI PRs for exploratory data; ≥40 human-labeled balanced examples (≥10 per class) for the ≥0.7 gate. Commit-message labels excluded from gate.
- **Cache key**: Composite (screenshot hash + agent-prompt hash + design-manifest hash); LRU-bounded; stored under `.ui-discovery-cache/visual-eval/`.
- **Prerequisites**: Explicit preconditions contract via EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark; integration gates report `not-applicable` (not soft-pass) when preconditions fail.

**Cross-epic interaction scan**: Dispatched all 31 of 31 candidate batches (haiku) covering 151 candidate epics. Surfaced 4 conflicts (4f8e perceptual diff, 53ee verifier conformance, 77a3 Plan C spatial metrics, 115c Plan A DESIGN.md linter) plus the same-family Plans A-E. User-confirmed reclassification:

- **4f8e-a7a6** (Figma perceptual diff): different problem class (pixel-regression vs. quality-quality). Both ship; linked relates_to.
- **53ee-a9ac** (completion-verifier conformance): different gate timing (closure vs. task-time). Both ship; linked relates_to.
- **77a3-b35a-3b62-48cd** (Plan C spatial metrics co-processor): complementary mechanism (deterministic vs. VLM); Plan C feeds spatial measurements into Plan B's manifest as ground truth. Sequencing: Plan C optional precursor for higher-confidence intent_match scoring. Linked relates_to.
- **115c-3e30-ab7d-4b12** (Plan A DESIGN.md linter): tokens feed Plan B's manifest synthesis. Different layers. Linked relates_to.
- **d29f-ab16-a050-496b** (Plan D Storybook isolation), **7ce2-1339-838f-4f1f** (Plan E semantic spatial-intent): complementary; linked relates_to.
- **7315-5768-34fc-4060** (Epic A — cross-skill signal contracts): visual-evaluator outputs are structured JSON so out of scope of Epic A's non-structured-signal gates. Linked relates_to.

**Scrutiny pipeline outputs**:

| Reviewer | Score | Pass | Findings retained |
|----------|-------|------|-------------------|
| Agent Clarity | 4/5 | yes | 3 minor (corpus location, numeric thresholds, existing-committee reference) — all addressed in revised spec |
| Scope | 4/5 | yes, no split | 2 minor (wave 3 bundling, wave 1 calibration sizing) — wave-3 bundling deferred to preplanning |
| Value | 4/5 | yes | 2 minor (before/after dogfooding) — Dogfood verification clause added to SC4 |
| Red Team | n/a | n/a | 7 findings; 6 retained as legit + 1 over-stated → minor by blue-team |
| Blue Team | n/a | filter | 6 retained legit, 1 severity-downgraded |

**Red-team / blue-team findings applied to revised spec**:

1. (RT-1 critical, blue-team legit) — Preconditions silent soft-skip: SC2 now emits EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark; gates report `not-applicable` rather than soft-pass when preconditions fail.
2. (RT-2 critical, blue-team legit) — VLM bounding-box hallucination: SC1 now requires DOM cross-check via Playwright getBoundingClientRect; findings with `dom_cross_check_passed: false` downgrade to severity=low; box-hallucination rate tracked in calibration.
3. (RT-3 critical, blue-team legit) — Calibration corpus poisoning: SC3 strengthened to ≥40 human-labeled balanced examples (≥10 per class), Cohen's kappa across ≥2 labelers, commit-message labels excluded from gate (allowed exploratory only).
4. (RT-4 major, blue-team legit) — Score non-determinism: SC1 specifies temperature=0; SC3 calibration script runs 3 reruns per fixture, asserts variance ≤0.5; threshold lowered to default 3 (was 4) to widen the gate from the non-determinism band.
5. (RT-5 major, blue-team legit) — Edge-case coverage: SC2 now requires per-route metadata (auth_required, viewports, themes, expected_status), pre-capture health probe, light+dark and mobile+desktop defaults, exclusion of non-200 routes.
6. (RT-6 major, blue-team legit) — Attribution rubric under-specified: SC1 now requires rubric + ≥3 few-shot examples per attribution_class in agent prompt; SC3 calibration adds class-distribution skew check (gate fails if any class <10% or >60%); SC4 caps user-dialog escalations at 2 per task with auto-defer beyond.
7. (RT-7 minor, downgraded by blue-team) — Committee correlation: SC5 documents arbitration tie-break authority between visual_hierarchy_intent and visual_hierarchy_legibility.

**Value reviewer's findings applied**:

- (Value minor 1) Before/after dogfooding signal — SC4 now includes Dogfood verification clause: replaying calibration corpus's seed-PR set surfaces ≥1 finding per PR that the text-mediated reviewer missed on ≥3 seed PRs.

**Revision cycles**: 1 (initial draft → scrutiny → revised spec → all retained findings addressed → no second cycle required).

**Scale context**: not applicable — agent-tooling epic; volume bounded by routes × tasks × cache hit rate (LRU 1000-entry cache).

**External dependencies**: Playwright (already required by /dso:ui-discover prerequisite; not new); Figma MCP (already wired when `design.figma_collaboration` enabled; optional). No new pip packages; no CI workflow / branch-protection / release-script dependencies.

**Attestation**: exhausted — all Phase 1 gap-analysis questions resolved by user (4 design questions: iteration model attribution-routed, calibration threshold high-confidence-auto / medium-low-dialog, reviewer split into two dimensions, scoring 5-dim with intent_match as discriminator; 4 architecture questions: design manifest synthesis, VLM model assignment Sonnet/Opus, score thresholds tunable, Integration B JSON 5th-reviewer; 3 operational questions: calibration corpus hybrid methodology, cache composite key, prerequisites soft-skip → explicit preconditions contract; 1 scope question: visual-regression diffing + Figma-only review confirmed out-of-scope; 1 SC verifiability question: in-session calibration accuracy gate; 3 cross-epic resolution questions: Plan B vs Plan C complementary, Plan B vs 4f8e different question, Plan B vs 53ee different timing).
